name: Bluechip AI
note: The AI and compute companies: chips, cloud, models and memory. Float-adjusted market-cap weighting, like the S&P 500 (and so Vanguard's VOO). Float shares = sharesOutstanding (fetched live from SEC EDGAR by `cik`) x listedFraction x iwf. listedFraction: the share of the company's stock in listed classes S&P counts (Alphabet: Class A + C, not B; Meta: Class A, not B); EDGAR only reports their total. iwf: S&P's investable weight factor, the fraction of listed shares not held by officers, directors and other strategic holders. Both are estimates from proxy statements; check them yearly (after proxy season) or after a large insider change. pool: the stock's USDC pool on Aerodrome Slipstream, used by the rebalancer. SNDKc: Sandisk (spun off from Western Digital in 2025). WDC kept up to 19.9% at the spin-off and filed a Schedule 13G/A on 2026-05-15; iwf 1.0 assumes that stake is sold. If WDC still holds it, use 0.8.
